title: Getting Around
intro: How do people get around the city?

words.sentence: The helicopter landed on the roof of the hospital.
words.def: This can fly, but it has not got wings like a plane.

words.sentence: My uncle rides his motorbike to work.
words.def: This has got two wheels and an engine.

words.sentence: We took a taxi to the station.
words.def: You pay the driver of this car to take you somewhere.

parentTip.vi: Khi ra đường, chỉ cho con các xe: "Look! An ambulance. Where is it going?"
parentTip.say: How do you get to school?

chat.ask: Have you ever been in a taxi?

text.title: Getting to School
lines: Children in our city go to school in different ways.
Ben takes the underground because he lives far away.
Sophie's mum takes her to school on her motorbike.
When it rains, Tom and his dad take a taxi.

questions.q: Why does Ben take the underground?
How does Sophie go to school?
When does Tom go by taxi?
